name: Spoltore (Italy)
description: Red field with a blue border, charged at the centre with the crowned municipal arms of Spoltore (wheat and the letters S A on blue) within branches.
history: Municipal flag of Spoltore, a comune in Abruzzo; Italian municipal arms, gonfaloni and flags are granted by decree of the President of the Republic on the advice of the Government's heraldry office.

features.role: Spoltore arms — wheat and the letters S A on blue, crowned, within branches
